rule.title: Do not leak tokens
rule.description: Never include any credentials, tokens, or secrets in findings or evidence snippets
rule.action: Only reference evidence metadata and configuration flags

rule.title: Evidence-based claims
rule.description: Findings must be tied to explicit fields like insecureSsl, proxy flags, or presence of source credentials
rule.action: Include evidence_refs pointing into codebuild-projects.json or codebuild-source-credentials.json
